title: Beats
info: Rhythm is the pattern of long and short, or strong and soft, sounds in time.
A beat is a steady pulse, like a clock tick you can clap to.
Tempo is how fast or slow the beat is.

options: how fast or slow the music is

options: the pattern of sounds in time
only how high a note is
